card.name: Start of words beginning with Sym
card.fires_on: The piece 'Sym', 'sym' or 'mp' right at the start of a word like Sympathetic, Symptomatic or symmetrical. It usually follows a sentence break or heading.

modes.label: Sympathetic
modes.description: The 'mp' piece inside Sy-mp-athetic, as in sympathetic blockade or stimulation.

modes.label: Symptomatic / symmetrical
modes.description: A capitalized or lowercase 'Sym' piece that starts Symptomatic or symmetrical.

card.writes: It suppresses tokens like 'is' and 'IS', so it seems to steer the model away from those continuations after the Sym start.
card.plain: It lights up on the opening letters of words like sympathetic and symptomatic.
